stated_posture: No peace treaty exists; the parties remain formally at war under the 1953 Armistice. Both maintain declared hostility and large standing forces on a fortified line.

sources: Kaesong Industrial Complex, operating 2004-2016; Mount Kumgang tourism project
trade.rationale: Joint industrial manufacturing operated for twelve years between two states formally at war, employing DPRK labour in ROK-managed facilities. Closed in 2016, so not 'intact' at standing, but the fact that it existed at all across a declared war line is a substantial divergence.

sources: Gyeongui and Donghae rail reconnection projects; DMZ crossing arrangements under inter-Korean agreements
transit.rationale: Rail and road reconnection across the world's most fortified line has been built, used, and periodically suspended. Continuous with symbolic pauses.

sources: Panmunjom liaison channel; inter-Korean military hotlines; Comprehensive Military Agreement, September 2018 (no-fly zones, guard post withdrawal, buffer zones)
deconfliction.rationale: Standing liaison and military hotlines, cyclically severed and restored, plus a negotiated agreement creating mutual no-fly and buffer zones along the line. Systematic, institutionalised advance-warning architecture.

sources: Seoul's proximity to the DMZ and its non-targeting since 1953; absence of leadership strikes by either party across seven decades
target_selection.rationale: A capital city of ten million sits within artillery range of the line and has not been struck in seventy years. Leadership on both sides untouched throughout. Decisive targets available, and their exclusion is effectively stated policy.

sources: UNSC sanctions on the DPRK are a multilateral regime, not a bilateral inter-Korean instrument
sanctions.rationale: CATEGORY NOT APPLICABLE as a dyadic measure. Scoring multilateral UNSC measures here would attribute third-party architecture to the dyad.

sources: Separated-family reunion programmes; joint and unified teams at the 2018 Winter Olympics; Mount Kumgang tourism
civil_continuity.rationale: Family reunions, joint sporting delegations and tourism have all operated across the line during the declared state of war, episodically suspended and restored.
